from circuit import CircuitBreaker
import pytest

def test_circuit():
    cb = CircuitBreaker(threshold=2)
    def fail(): raise ValueError('err')
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        cb.call(fail)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        cb.call(fail)
    assert cb.state == 'OPEN'
    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError):
        cb.call(fail)
